title: FOCUS: Active Critic Learning for Long-Horizon Language Model Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.35801v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Sparse outcome rewards make it difficult for long-horizon language-model agents to assign credit to earlier actions. Learned critics provide value estimates for intermediate states, but these estimates can be inaccurate, while estimating intermediate values with repetitive continuation samples from points within a trajectory incurs substantial costs. To mitigate these issues, we introduce FOCUS, an RL method that uses selective branching to help the critic network learn its value estimator. The rollout controller facilitates active learning for the critic by sampling continuations from states that are expected to most reduce the critic's estimation error. These refined value estimates then score the segment between consecutive states with a TD($\lambda$) advantage, while the sampled evidence supplies training targets for the critic. FOCUS supports long-horizon agentic reinforcement learning through a modular context-management interface

translated_title: FOCUS：面向长程语言模型智能体的主动评论家学习
translated_abstract: 稀疏的结果奖励使得长程语言模型智能体难以将功劳分配给较早的动作。学习到的评论家网络可以为中间状态提供价值估计，但这些估计可能不准确，而通过从轨迹内的点反复采样续写来估计中间价值又会产生巨大成本。为了缓解这些问题，我们提出了FOCUS，这是一种强化学习方法，利用选择性分支来帮助评论家网络学习其价值估计器。Rollout控制器通过从预计最能降低评论家估计误差的状态进行续写采样，促进评论家的主动学习。这些精炼后的价值估计随后使用TD(λ)优势对连续状态之间的片段进行评分，而采样的证据则为评论家提供训练目标。FOCUS通过模块化的上下文管理接口支持长程智能体强化学习。
tldr: FOCUS是一种强化学习方法，通过选择性分支对预计最能降低估计误差的状态进行续写采样，实现评论家网络的主动学习并获得更准确的价值估计，从而解决长程语言模型智能体中稀疏奖励导致的信用分配难题。
